name: High Coast / Kvarken Archipelago
description: Along the Gulf of Bothnia, Sweden's High Coast and Finland's Kvarken Archipelago share a landscape that is still rising from the sea. Freed from the weight of ice-age glaciers, the land has lifted about 285 metres on the Swedish side, creating tall cliffs. In Finland, some 5,600 islands keep growing, merging and turning bays into marshes.
